text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That was so fun, so much fun, I 
don't wanna go home~!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Quit whining. Stop your babbling and just 
get on.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Don't you feel lonely at all, Sirius-san? 
The barbecue yesterday was so much fun, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
That carrot was delicious... The fireworks 
were so pretty... Playing with everyone 
was so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we'll be able to do this with 
the same crew again next year...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Summer training camp? What a 
load of crap."

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Hey! There's no need to put it like that!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Point is, don't sweat the small stuff.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—I can open up the Symboli family's 
private beach whenever you like.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna do this every year, I'll 
gather y'all up even when you've all 
turned into old bags.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
...! F-For real?! Y-You're thinking that 
far ahead for us...?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Only if you can wag your tail cutely. 
Understood? Then hop on. ――Don't crowd me, 
it's hot.

Under a summer sky that felt like it would 
never end, we returned to Tracen Academy.
